summary: CLPS Inc. filed a Form 6-K reporting receipt of a Nasdaq deficiency notice for failing to meet the $1.00 minimum bid price requirement for 30 consecutive business days through May 26, 2026. The company has a 180-day compliance period until November 23, 2026, to regain compliance by having a closing bid price of at least $1.00 for ten consecutive business days. This is a routine listing standards notification, not a delisting or special situation. The filing discloses no board recommendation, advisor, or deal terms. No risk-arb angle applies; watch for potential reverse stock split if compliance is not achieved.
